answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the ledge index resolves every citation against the lantern checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the lagoon audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1063 identities would post 2299 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
